title.text: Școlița — first screen designs (Galaxy Tab A7, landscape)

look.text:
The look (proposal, to choose with her in feature/look)

• A galaxy at dusk, never black; a rainbow path joins the planets.
• The guide: a unicorn astronaut (name chosen by her). Tap it to hear the last line again.
• Language is shown by colour AND shape: Romanian = gold star "RO", English = blue ringed planet "EN".
• Letters to learn in a school print face (Andika: single-storey a and g); the app's words in Baloo 2.
• Kind feedback only: no red, no buzzers, no lost stars.
• Every instruction is spoken; every letter, word and picture can be tapped to hear it.

assumptions.text:
Assumed for these designs

• D1: Romanian is the anchor, so the app's own words are in Romanian here.
• D5: the unicorn astronaut mascot (her purple cat could join as co-pilot).
• D6: star and ringed-planet badges, no flags.
• D3 (answered): letters are written by hand too, in the Romanian school's handwritten forms, joined into words (screen 8).
• Words and pictures are examples; curriculum-research fixes the real lists.

profiles.text:
Profiles (added 2026-11-24)

• Each child, and the parent as a tester, has their own map, stars, stickers, letters learned and learning settings.
• "Cine se joacă?" shows only when there are 2 or more children; one child goes straight to the map.
• Tapping a card says the name aloud, then opens that child's map.
• The tester profile opens only from the parent area: all lessons open, skip step, a test overlay, "TEST" on the map.
• Names (Ana, Matei, Ioana) are examples; avatars are placeholders until feature/look.
